spec_match.rationale: Generates a tint scale from one brand color using relative alpha syntax with an honest '⚠ not supported, showing fallback rgba values' banner on this build.

interactive.rationale: Brand color input regenerates the whole palette (BRAND-100 subtle bg etc.) plus copyable custom properties; the sample button demonstrates the derived states.

edge_cases.rationale: Fallback honesty is good, but there is no low-contrast warning when a chosen brand color produces failing text/background pairs in the generated palette.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: palette tiles rendered with rgba fallback values; primary-button sample interactive; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: System variables for chrome; two raw hex values are user-facing brand defaults.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled inputs, but generated tint values update without announcement and the palette's own contrast is unchecked.

openQuestions.title: Flag failing contrast in generated palettes
openQuestions.detail: A tint generator invites shipping the output; computing the WCAG ratio of each generated pair (e.g. BRAND-100 background with charcoal text) and badging failures would align the tool with the project's AA rule.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: brand input regenerates the derived tint tiles, honestly labelled as fallback rgba on this build; zero console errors; panel 3 pass / 0 fail.
